items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: he had a chance to grow up listening to people and talking to people like Jo Jones and Ben Webster

ctx.x: And I had just come back from California, not too long beforehand. And so that was kind of a habitual thing. After the gig was over and the pack up, and as Papa Jo Jones would say, “With our mutual armies we’ll move out smiling.”

But I was always hanging around because I liked the stories. See because he had more of an advantage in that he had a chance to grow up listening to people and talking to people like Jo Jones and Ben Webster—
